statements.status_notes: GHSA-g98v-hv3f-hcfr (RUSTSEC-2021-0145) is a potential unaligned read in atty on Windows. atty 0.2.14 appears in the SBOM because the Cargo.lock of flux v0.201.0 lists it, but it is not compiled into Kapacitor. Its only dependent in the lock file is criterion 0.3.6, which flux and flux-core declare as a dev-dependency for benchmarks. `cargo build` does not build dev-dependencies. Kapacitor is also not built for Windows.

RUSTSEC-2024-0375 is an unmaintained-crate notice for atty. atty 0.2.14 appears in the SBOM because the Cargo.lock of flux v0.201.0 lists it, but it is not compiled into Kapacitor. Its only dependent in the lock file is criterion 0.3.6, which flux and flux-core declare as a dev-dependency for benchmarks. `cargo build` does not build dev-dependencies. The Go package github.com/mattn/go-isatty in kapacitord is unrelated to this crate.
